rationale: Since entry, price has coiled in a ~6-cent range (24.15–24.21) on steadily fading volume, so neither the short thesis nor a reversal has been confirmed, and the day's dominant structure remains the sharp rejection from $25.43 with price still in the lower third of the range. The upward drift in the last few candles is on declining volume, not accumulation, and my invalidation at $24.30 sits only ~9 cents away (roughly $37 of additional risk) versus ~41 cents of room to the $23.80 target — an asymmetric setup worth letting resolve. Flipping long would mean paying double costs to take a coin-flip bet inside a low-volatility coil, which the marginal tape does not justify.
